notes.title: A Tale of Revenge and Madness! HARMA is set to launch in 2025!
notes.notes: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p][/p][p]This is INDIRECT SHINE.[/p][p][/p][p]We are extremely excited to reveal our roguelike deck-builder, [i]HARMA[/i], today![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483700/HARMA/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44406127/3dedbbf21be339906f54d8318b2ecd3c45a714d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Set to launch in late 2025, HARMA invites players into a rich narrative experience powered by dynamic card-based combat and meaningful choices.[/p][p] [/p][p]To mark the official reveal, a brand-new trailer has been released—offering a first look at the game’s striking pixel art, strategic mechanics, and a world teetering on the edge of ruin.[/p][p][/p][p]INDIRECT SHINE & Astrolabe Games[/p][p]June 24, 2025[/p]
